summary: v3.8 — Instagram Direct + Facebook Messenger channels end-to-end verification. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed (verify GET success/403, POST inbound enabled/disabled with full Meta payload processing, test-channel hits Graph API and returns Meta error with FAKE token, PUT /agents persists channel configs, webchat regression intact). Frontend: Playwright on /app/agentes confirmed all 5 channels render (webchat/whatsapp/telegram/instagram/messenger), no 'Brevemente' badges remain on IG/Messenger, enabling toggle reveals correct field set (page_access_token, ig_user_id/page_id, verify_token), Webhook URL panel + Copy button visible, 'Testar ligação' on Instagram with FAKE token produces RED 'Erro' badge + inline + toast message: 'Instagram: Invalid OAuth access token - Cannot parse access token' — proving integration is wired correctly to Graph API v20.0.
action_items: (Optional) Maria's channels may have been left in 'enabled with FAKE token' state by the Playwright UI test final reset (button:has-text('Guardar') was found and clicked, but worth a quick visual check). Backend pytest restored its baseline correctly via fixture teardown.

(Future, when real tokens arrive) Add Instagram message types beyond text (story_mention, reaction) and Messenger postback handler in webhooks.py — currently only text/quick_reply text are handled, which matches the WhatsApp pattern and is the correct MVP scope.
critical_code_review_comments: webhooks.py: clean mirror of WhatsApp pattern. _send_messenger uses messaging_type=RESPONSE (correct for 24h window). _send_instagram correctly uses /{ig_user_id}/messages endpoint (Instagram Messaging API on Graph v20.0). Both helpers have proper exception handling and return {ok, status, error}.

messenger_webhook + instagram_webhook correctly: (1) reject when channel disabled (400), (2) skip is_echo messages, (3) skip messages without sender or text, (4) handle quick_reply.payload as text fallback for Messenger, (5) wrap into InboundMessage with proper channel/external_user_id prefix, (6) call process_inbound and only attempt send if reply produced, (7) return {ok:true, results:[...]} structure consistent with WhatsApp.

server.py agent_test_channel: Instagram + Messenger blocks correctly call Graph v20.0 (page details for FB, IG profile for Instagram), parse error message from Meta error.message, return Portuguese-friendly errors. Verified live: FAKE token returns 'Invalid OAuth access token - Cannot parse access token' (Meta error.message bubbled).

Agentes.jsx: comingSoon flag correctly removed for instagram/messenger. Field configs match backend expectations exactly (instagram: page_access_token+ig_user_id+verify_token; messenger: page_access_token+page_id+verify_token). Webhook URL builder uses backendUrl from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded URLs. All required data-testids present (channel-{k}, channel-toggle-{k}, channel-{k}-{field}, btn-test-{k}, btn-copy-webhook-{k}).
No regressions found: gpt-4o-mini latency path still works (webchat regression test passed), widget.js cross-domain unaffected (no edits to widget files in this iteration).
Pre-existing lint warnings server.py:526 (E741) and 1176 (F841) noted in handoff — confirmed NOT regressions. Out of scope.
seed_data_creation: None permanent. Test fixture toggled Maria's instagram/messenger channels with FAKE_TOKEN/FAKE_PAGE_ID/FAKE_IG_USER_ID during execution; teardown restored baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four Meta channels (WhatsApp Cloud, Telegram, Instagram Direct, Facebook Messenger) are wired end-to-end. Re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_meta_channels.py -v. The fixture handles channel restore. Frontend channels-panel data-testid is the entry point; channel-{k}/channel-toggle-{k}/channel-{k}-{field}/btn-test-{k}/btn-copy-webhook-{k} are all stable selectors. When user provides REAL Meta tokens, only thing left is to verify Graph API ok:true response — wiring is proven correct.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues. All four channels (WhatsApp pre-existing, Telegram pre-existing, Instagram new, Messenger new) are 100% live for production token swap-in.
